meta.what: Per-car side profiles for eight presets, as a proof of the recommended method. Research only: nothing in src/ reads this file.
meta.spec: len_mm, h_mm and ovF_mm (front overhang: front axle to the nose) are spec-sheet or blueprint dimensions. They give the sprite its real height and real overhangs, ovF = ovF_mm/wb and ovR = (len - wb - ovF_mm)/wb, using the preset's own body.wb.
meta.look: Every other key is a CAR_LOOK key from src/js/sprites.js. u runs from the rear bumper (0) to the nose (1). Heights are shares of the body's own height above the sill. Keys left out keep the archetype's value.
meta.confidence: len_mm, h_mm: published maker figures, quoted from memory, not re-checked against a source this session. ovF_mm and every look key: estimated by eye from the shape of the car, with no reference photo open, because the Wikimedia Commons API rate-limited this session. Read them off a side photo before shipping any of them.

cars.name: Porsche 911 Carrera RS 2.7 Sport (1973)
cars.why: The super archetype is a mid-engined wedge. A 911 is a fastback: a short roof, then one long slope over the engine to a ducktail.

cars.name: Lamborghini Countach LP400 (1974)
cars.why: One straight line from the nose to the roof. It is 1.07 m tall against the archetype's 1.16 m.

cars.name: Jaguar E-Type 3.8 FHC (Series 1, 1961)
cars.why: The cabin sits far back behind the long bonnet, and the fastback roof runs to the tail. The coupe archetype puts the windscreen at u = 0.66.

cars.name: Ford Mustang Fastback 289 (1965)
cars.why: A tall, flat front and a fastback roof. The muscle archetype has a notchback.

cars.name: Trabant 601 S (1988)
cars.why: It is filed under kei, which draws a tall box. A Trabant is a small three-box saloon with a boot.

cars.name: Toyota Land Cruiser 200 VX 4.5 D-4D (2015)
cars.why: A square, upright tail and a high bonnet. The suv archetype is a lower crossover.

cars.name: Volkswagen Golf GTI (Mk1, 1976)
cars.why: A control: the hatch archetype already fits, so only the dimensions change.

cars.name: Honda NSX (NA1, 1991)
cars.why: A cab-forward canopy and a long, high tail.
